title: 2D top-down Godot base and a modifiable town example

shortFlow.road: one horizontal road across the overworld map
shortFlow.shop: one shop with a counter in a separate interior scene
shortFlow.npc: Mira, one quest giver on the road (plus a shopkeeper behind the counter)
shortFlow.quest: gather 3 herbs from a patch, deliver to Mira, 30 coins + 1 apple, granted once

logicAcceptance.method: independent headless Godot processes, unique per-run world ids and user data dirs
logicAcceptance.input: scripted movement vector through the real CharacterBody2D; no OS mouse or keyboard events, no window, no Pointer Lock
covers: buying outside the counter range is rejected
real collision stops the player at a wall
coins, inventory and stock change together on purchase
new world from the example inherits no rewards
the create-world guard rejects templates that ship author progress
four-direction walk animation and walk-cycle advance
quest cannot be handed to a non-declared giver
gather charges persist across a full restart

syncCheck.result: both committed worlds match the generator file-by-file

visualEvidence.method: Web export with the pinned Godot build, served from a throwaway local server, photographed in a separate headless browser profile with no input
visualEvidence.scopeNote: proves the build renders; does not establish GPU performance or player feel

notRun: real mouse/keyboard, window compositing, gamepad feel

guarantees.stableEntityIdentity: state is keyed by scene-declared entity_id and data id, never by node path; duplicate ids are reported
guarantees.stateVersion: progress and state carry stateVersion 1 and are validated field-by-field; invalid input is rejected whole
guarantees.instanceIsolation: custom_user_dir_name = craftmine-topdown-<worldId>, progress under a hash of worldId, worldId also checked inside the file
guarantees.oneShotReward: quests[id].rewarded and grantedRewards['<id>#reward'] are both checked before consuming items and both written on grant
guarantees.atomicPurchase: all range/stock/coin checks run before any mutation; coins, inventory and stock commit together
guarantees.newWorldInitialProgress: new-world.mjs fails if a template ships rewarded:true, status:'completed', a non-empty grantedRewards ledger, negative coins or negative inventory counts
guarantees.questGiverBinding: a quest can only be handed in to the giver declared in its data file (wrong_giver otherwise)
guarantees.writeSideSanitised: initial progress and shop stock are clamped/validated so the writer cannot emit a save the strict loader rejects

highSeverity: quest ledger write could abort after payment when the quest record did not exist; fixed with ensure_quest and covered by quest-01b/shop-03b
mediumSeverity: quest status was ignored by deliver and the create-world guard checked fields that cannot carry over
write side could produce an unloadable save from negative stock or a malformed position
new-world --force could delete an arbitrary directory and --template allowed path traversal
testHardening: move-capture probe op asserts the walk cycle advances
restart probe asserts gather charges persist
template guard has a negative fixture and is asserted directly

buildService: managed project directory and process lifetime
map world-build.json file hashes to the Rust project version and receipt
runSaveService: drive the probe protocol and read progress files
application transaction, backup and rollback between candidate and live world
interfacesNeededFromOthers.isolation: OS-level access scope and network policy remain GD0 work; this base does not claim to provide a sandbox

taskIStartingPoint.addProduct: data/shops/general.json items[] (id, price, stock) plus data/items.json name
taskIStartingPoint.adjustRules: data/quests/*.json requires/reward, GatherZone.max_charges in the scene
taskIStartingPoint.createQuest: add data/quests/<id>.json and set quest_id on the NPC node
taskIStartingPoint.verify: node tools/verify.mjs (30 checks) and node tools/check-sync.mjs
taskIStartingPoint.note: new content needs its own assertions; existing assertions must not be relaxed

knownGaps: short flow only: no combat, no seasons, no large RPG content, no infinite map
scene switching is a scene reload, not arbitrary hot reload
no OS-level isolation; AppContainer still exits with 0xC0000142 in GD0
no real mouse/keyboard, window compositing or player feel acceptance
no export preset committed; capture tool generates a minimal one to avoid machine-specific paths
world reuse, compatibility tags and base upgrade migration belong to GD6

evidenceHashes.note: see world-build.json inside each world for per-file sha256; evidence JSON files are committed verbatim
